parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem:
The rate of reaction between 2-chloro-2-methylpropane, $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CCl}$, and methanol is investigated. When a large excess of methanol is used, the overall reaction is first order.

$$ (\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CCl} + \text{CH}_3\text{OH} \rightarrow (\text{CH}_3)_3\text{COCH}_3 + \text{HCl} $$

Fig. 3.1 shows the results obtained.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

Fig. 3.1
parts.text: Use the graph to determine the rate of reaction at 40 s. Show all your working.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Use the graph to show that the overall reaction is first order. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
In a different reaction, which is also a first order reaction, 75% of the reactant is consumed in 320 s.

Calculate the rate constant, $k$, for this reaction. State the units for $k$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
A salt bridge is used in an electrochemical cell.

State the function of the salt bridge. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
(c)(iv)
parts.text:
The $E^\ominus$ of the $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}(\text{aq})$, $\text{H}^+(\text{aq})/\text{Cr}^{3+}(\text{aq})$ electrode is +1.33 V.

Label the negative electrode and the direction of electron flow in the external circuit when the current flows in your diagram in (c)(iii).

parts.text:
Ethanal is oxidised to ethanoic acid in the presence of $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}$ ions.

Construct the ionic equation for the oxidation of ethanal to ethanoic acid using dichromate(VI) in acid conditions. Calculate the $E^\ominus_{\text{cell}}$ for this reaction.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
In an ethanol-oxygen fuel cell, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{OH}(\text{l})$ and $\text{O}_2(\text{g})$ are in contact with two inert electrodes immersed in an acidic solution.

The cell reaction for the oxidation of ethanol by oxygen is shown.

$$2\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{OH} + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{CH}_3\text{COOH} + 2\text{H}_2\text{O} \quad E^\ominus_{\text{cell}} = +2.01\text{ V}$$

Calculate $\Delta G^\ominus$, in $\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$, for the oxidation of ethanol by oxygen.
